summary: Corrected W3 Index Lifecycle and Exact-Threshold Baseline: DT-05, DT-16, and DT-17 are scoped-passed evidence, but W3 remains blocked until TS-09 adapter generation/persistence passes through runEmbeddingProviderAdapterLifecycle.js and proves productionGraphRagRuntime.generateAffectedEmbeddings() exposes Node runtime, provider-adapter generation, parameterized persistence evidence, and non-Aligned partial failure behavior.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run threshold-all seed retrieval against many-peer relevant, unrelated, and ANN comparison fixtures across Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View channels.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe every above-threshold peer returned per channel, zero unrelated forced hits, no fixed result limit, and ANN top-k marked performance-only rather than correctness baseline.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the canonical mutation matrix for create, update, delete, topology-only, semantic-content, and View-membership changes.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe all nine mutation classes, version advancement, deleted-object absence, non-Aligned partial persistence, and affected-record lifecycle evidence.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Inspect semantic-index records produced by the DT-16 mutation matrix for affected Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View records.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe object identity, channel, canonical/content/index version, provider, model, model version, and dimensions evidence for every indexed record.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Submit canonical-read controls and a pure semantic request while the semantic index is unaligned.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe full and explicit-anchor canonical reads remain available, pure semantic requests fail with SEMANTIC_INDEX_NOT_ALIGNED, and no automatic full-snapshot fallback occurs.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Call productionGraphRagRuntime.generateAffectedEmbeddings() for canonical mutations changing Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View records, then introduce partial provider or persistence failure.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe runtime='nodejs', neo4jGenAiPluginRequired=false, qualified-provider invocation, parameterized vector/evidence persistence, no required Neo4j GenAI Plugin, no embedded credentials, and Stale/Failed rather than Aligned after incomplete persistence.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Call productionGraphRagRuntime.generateAffectedEmbeddings() with affected Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View records after canonical mutation success.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe affected-record extraction, batching/error isolation, runtime='nodejs', provider adapter evidence, complete persistence metadata, and non-Aligned partial failure behavior.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Corrected W3 production Graph RAG boundary contract
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect root, local Graph RAG, and test contracts for W3 threshold-all, lifecycle, alignment, and TS-09 adapter/generation responsibilities.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Contracts expose generateAffectedEmbeddings(input), identify TS-09 as a blocking gate, and state DT scoped passes are not sufficient while TS-09 fails.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Corrected W3 coding scope authorization
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect codingTargets, tasks, completion signals, and frozen mounted evidence.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: TS-08 remains unauthorized while corrected W3 handoffs may authorize TS-09 adapter/generation work and generateAffectedEmbeddings implementation.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Corrected W3 production dependency direction
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect production Graph RAG JavaScript modules for outward test dependencies, Python/runtime sidecars, child_process ownership, and Neo4j plugin calls.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Production code remains inward-facing; semantic/index/adapter delivery does not depend on tests or plugin embedding procedures.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Corrected W3 explicit entrypoint correctness
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect DT-05, DT-16, DT-17, and TS-09 physical entrypoints plus the handoff frozen-file list.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Entrypoints retain GIVEN/WHEN/THEN readability, Harness abstraction, and key TS-09 runtime/plugin/channel/model/credential/partial-persistence categories.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Corrected W3 implementation traceability
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect intent anchors, root implements mappings, mounted testcase paths, and physical entrypoint files.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: grag-seed-retrieval, grag-semantic-index, grag-index-lifecycle, grag-alignment-constraint, grag-embedding-provider-adapter, and grag-embedding-generation remain mapped to their W3 entrypoints.

codingTargets.nextAction: Make generateAffectedEmbeddings() return outcome-level runtime='nodejs', neo4jGenAiPluginRequired=false, provider-adapter generation evidence, persistence evidence, and non-Aligned partial failure behavior.
Expose affected Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View generation results through the runtime without relying on DT-16 scoped lifecycle evidence alone.
Emit persisted records with the frozen TS-09 model/version/dimensions evidence shape and no providerCredential field.

W3 acceptance requires both TS-09 testcases and the DT scoped evidence to pass, with the corrected W3 critical guards green and zero delivered-to-not_delivered regression.
